l1_words.meaning: sensitive, easily affected by feelings or criticism
to carry out or to accomplish

pattern_explanation: Several Spanish words in this set look almost identical to English words but carry different meanings, so students who rely on spelling alone will choose the wrong English equivalent.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word that looks like the English 'compromise' actually means a commitment or obligation, so a student who translates it as 'compromise' will misunderstand a sentence about keeping a promise at work.
